notes:
Return-to-load week. Push and pull resume at reduced leverage. Right biceps re-enters training as the primary rehab lift.

PAIN RULE (all days): ≤3/10 during, baseline within 24h, no increased stiffness next morning. Fail → drop back one step, do not push through.

STAYS OUT THIS WEEK (non-negotiable): chair dips, pull-ups / chin-ups / pull-up negatives, decline and archer push-ups, HSPU, pike push-ups.

exercises.name: Isometric push-up hold
exercises.cue: Screen. Pain-free → proceed. Sharp pain → stop the day, revert to wk11.
exercises.raw: Isometric push-up hold ~90°: 2×30s — screen. Pain-free → proceed. Sharp pain → stop day, revert to wk11.

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.cue: Deliberately easy leverage. You were doing 4×8 decline; this is a big step back. That is the point.
exercises.raw: Incline push-ups (hands on chair): 4×8, 3s down / 1s pause / 1s up — deliberately easy leverage.

exercises.name: Right-arm backpack curl
exercises.cue: THE rehab lift. Slow, light, controlled. Do not chase the left arm.
exercises.raw: Right-arm backpack curl: 3×8, 3s up / 3s down, ~4kg — THE rehab lift.

exercises.name: Left-arm backpack curl
exercises.raw: Left-arm backpack curl: 3×6, 9kg, same tempo — hold, don't widen the gap.

exercises.name: Backpack tricep extension
exercises.raw: Backpack tricep extension, both arms: 3×8, 7kg left / ~4kg right

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.raw: Hollow body hold: 3×45s

exercises.name: Zone 2 run
exercises.raw: Day 2 (Fri) — Zone 2 Run | 8–9 km, conversational, 3:2 breathing

days.notes: Rest 3 min main lifts, explosive intent.

exercises.name: Box pistols
exercises.raw: Box pistols: 4×5/side — bodyweight, lower box or less assist

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats
exercises.raw: Bulgarian split squats loaded: 4×6/side, 3s down — bump load from 7.3kg

exercises.name: Single-leg RDL
exercises.raw: Single-leg RDL loaded: 3×6/side, slow

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.cue: Setup is the problem → sub loaded high step-up 3×8/side, 3s down.
exercises.raw: Single-leg hip thrust, shoulders elevated, loaded: 3×10/side — glutes keep the higher-rep exception.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raises
exercises.raw: Single-leg calf raises, deficit, loaded: 3×8/side, full stretch off edge

days.notes: Rest 2 min. Stripped down on purpose — pull loads the tendon harder than push.

exercises.name: Scapular pulls
exercises.raw: Scapular pulls: 4×6 clean — first, as always

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.cue: Pain-free only. Stop if the front of the shoulder talks.
exercises.raw: Dead hang: 2×20–30s, passive, pain-free only.

exercises.name: Inverted rows
exercises.variant: high bar / easy angle, pronated grip
exercises.cue: Overhand, not underhand. Body angle shallow.
exercises.raw: Inverted rows, HIGH bar / easy angle, PRONATED grip: 4×8, 2s pause at chest

exercises.name: Reverse snow angels
exercises.raw: Reverse snow angels: 3×12, 0.5L bottles

exercises.name: Right-arm backpack curl
exercises.raw: Right-arm backpack curl: 3×8, 3s/3s, ~4kg — 2nd loading session of the week

exercises.name: Left-arm backpack curl
exercises.raw: Left-arm backpack curl: 3×6, 9kg

exercises.name: Leg raises
exercises.raw: Leg raises: 3×15, 60–90s rest

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.raw: Hollow body hold: 3×45s

exercises.name: Backpack tricep extension
exercises.raw: Backpack tricep extension, both arms: 3×8, 7kg left / ~4kg right

days.notes: PROTOCOL CHANGE (Norwegian 4×4). Total work at intensity: 16 min. Target is ≥15 min.

exercises.name: Warm-up
exercises.cue: Easy jog, building to moderate. Do not cut short.
exercises.raw: 10–12 min warm-up: easy jog, building to moderate.

exercises.name: Norwegian 4×4
exercises.cue: 4 min at 90–95% HRmax, RPE 8, cannot speak in sentences. NOT a sprint. Recovery is an easy jog, not a walk.
exercises.raw: 4 rounds: 4 min at 90–95% HRmax / 3 min active recovery at ~70% HRmax — EASY JOG. Non-negotiable.

exercises.name: Cooldown
exercises.raw: 5 min cooldown

days.notes: Mobility: 90/90 hip, cat-cow, wrist circles. Shoulder dislocates — pain-free range only. Real reps.

exercises.name: Walk
exercises.raw: Day 7 (Wed) — Active Recovery | 30 min walk + mobility
